name: Cookies Addons Embed Iframe
description: COOKiES add-on text-format filter that blocks non-YouTube iframe embeds in formatted text by moving their src to data-src until the visitor consents to the built-in Iframe cookies service.
project_description: Submodule of Cookies Addons. Provides the 'Block iframes' text-format filter plugin (cookies_addons_embed_iframe_filter) that rewrites non-YouTube <iframe> src attributes to data-src so external iframes do not load until the visitor consents to the built-in 'iframe' cookies service; the src is restored by JavaScript on consent. Installs the iframe cookies service and iframes service group. Enable the filter in a text format's settings.
